title: Programming and computer architecture with MARS

roadmap.title: Console introduction
roadmap.exercise: Print a greeting, read an integer, and calculate a result. Step across the syscall and inspect its argument and result registers.

roadmap.title: A single pixel
roadmap.exercise: Write an RGB word to Bitmap Display. Change one byte and predict the affected channel. Use a source-header comment to configure the tool.

roadmap.title: An eight-byte sprite
roadmap.exercise: Draw an 8 × 8 sprite with one byte per row, then mirror it by reversing the order of the bits. Reuse the sprite in the image-format chapters.

roadmap.title: Bit inspector
roadmap.exercise: Print one word as hexadecimal, binary, signed decimal, and unsigned decimal. Trace sign extension across register widths.

roadmap.title: Seven-segment counter
roadmap.exercise: Count from 0 to F on the Digital Lab display with a lookup table, then design new glyphs.

roadmap.title: MarsBot square
roadmap.exercise: Drive the robot using memory-mapped commands. Change a heading and predict the stopping position.

roadmap.title: Bresenham line drawing
roadmap.exercise: Follow the integer error accumulator while plotting a line on a tiny canvas. Test all slopes and both endpoint orders.

roadmap.title: Cellular automata
roadmap.exercise: Plot Rule 30 or Conway’s Game of Life one generation at a time. For Life, use separate source and destination buffers and swap them between generations.

roadmap.title: Sorting visualizer
roadmap.exercise: Animate swaps in insertion and selection sort. Compare instruction and branch counts on sorted, reversed, and shuffled inputs.

roadmap.title: Maze explorer
roadmap.exercise: Animate breadth-first search. Color the frontier, visited cells, and final path separately.

roadmap.title: Matrix transpose
roadmap.exercise: Implement ordinary and tiled transposition. Compare memory access patterns in the Data Cache Simulator and check that both outputs match.

roadmap.title: Fixed-point bouncing ball
roadmap.exercise: Represent position and velocity as scaled integers. Compare rounding rules and reproduce an overflow.

roadmap.title: Binary packet parser
roadmap.exercise: Validate a fixed header, payload length, and checksum. Return the number of bytes consumed or a specified error. Test partial inputs and malformed lengths.

roadmap.title: Ring-buffer logger
roadmap.exercise: Push and pop variable-length records. Handle independent wraparound, full and empty states, and exact-fit records.

roadmap.title: UTF-8 scanner
roadmap.exercise: Count code points and locate the first malformed byte sequence, including a sequence split across reads.

roadmap.title: Clipped sprite blitter
roadmap.exercise: Draw a transparent sprite into a strided framebuffer. Clip all four edges and verify guard words around the destination.

roadmap.title: Expression evaluator
roadmap.exercise: Handle precedence, parentheses, and unary minus. Define overflow and syntax errors in the contract.

roadmap.title: Tiny bytecode interpreter
roadmap.exercise: Run a stack machine with arithmetic and branches. Check stack bounds, jump targets, and invalid opcodes.

roadmap.title: RGB888 and RGB565
roadmap.exercise: Convert between pixel formats. Use MSA to pack and unpack groups of pixels and inspect the resulting color loss.

roadmap.title: PCM mixing
roadmap.exercise: Mix signed 16-bit audio with saturating addition. Use a loud sample to make the difference between clipping and wraparound audible.

roadmap.title: Fixed-point FIR filter
roadmap.exercise: Filter a tone from a short audio clip. Verify an impulse response, then compare scalar and vector dot products.

roadmap.title: Blocked matrix multiplication
roadmap.exercise: Start with matrices students can check by hand. Compare simulated instruction counts and cache behavior as tile sizes change.

roadmap.title: Delta and variable-length encoding
roadmap.exercise: Compact sensor readings or timestamps. Compare the size of the result for steady values, spikes, and random input.

roadmap.title: CRC-32 file checker
roadmap.exercise: Implement bit-at-a-time and table-driven versions. Flip one input bit and follow the CRC state. Reuse the routine for PNG chunks.

roadmap.title: SHA-256 fingerprint
roadmap.exercise: Trace a compression round, check padding boundaries with test vectors, and compare a file digest against a reference.

roadmap.title: ChaCha20
roadmap.exercise: Step through a quarter-round before implementing the block function. Use MSA to show what runs in parallel and where lane shuffles are needed.

roadmap.title: RSA arithmetic
roadmap.exercise: Begin with Euclid’s algorithm and square-and-multiply. Introduce multiword multiplication and carry propagation, then compare modular powers with `BigInteger.modPow`. Discuss standardized RSA padding and schemes after the arithmetic lab.

roadmap.title: Base64
roadmap.exercise: Encode and decode standard vectors, arbitrary lengths, and padding. Add a vector kernel for complete blocks and a scalar tail.

roadmap.title: Binary PPM
roadmap.exercise: Read a small image into the framebuffer and write an image another program can open. Introduce file boundaries, headers, and component order.

roadmap.title: QOI
roadmap.exercise: Reuse the eight-byte sprite as a real compressed image. Draw each pixel as the decoder reconstructs it. Add an encoder and compare runs and color differences on several image types.

roadmap.title: PCM WAV filter
roadmap.exercise: Read a WAV file, apply the mixer or FIR filter, and write a playable result. Specify which chunks the exercise supports and how it handles unexpected ones.

roadmap.title: CBOR telemetry
roadmap.exercise: Serialize and recover a sensor record using a subset of integers, byte strings, arrays, and maps. Include truncated and malformed input.

roadmap.title: PNG
roadmap.exercise: Teach chunk validation, DEFLATE, row reconstruction, and blitting separately. Use the existing scalar decoder as the reference. Vectorize RGB packing and the Up filter, then study Sub as an example of a dependency between reconstructed pixels. Compare exact output and simulated instructions per pixel.

roadmap.title: Small lossless video codec
roadmap.exercise: Encode a 64 × 64 animation with periodic full frames and intervening XOR deltas. Encode runs of unchanged pixels and apply updates in place. Measure bytes per frame and seek from a full frame. Vectorize XOR and change detection after the scalar version works.

roadmap.title: Restricted H.263 encoder
roadmap.exercise: Encode Python-generated raw QCIF (176 × 144) digital frames as actual H.263 using a restricted, documented interoperable feature set. Input limits: no more than 30 fps and no more than 10 seconds; use a shorter/lower-rate default to keep simulator execution practical. Assume prior MSA fluency and develop scalar/MSA block prediction, motion estimation, transform and quantization work with independent decoding checks. Complete chapters 33 (PNG) and 34 (lossless video) before implementing this chapter.
